summary.text: Veleria Levy is the Democratic candidate for North Carolina House of Representatives District 99 in the November 3, 2026 general election; Ballotpedia lists no incumbent in the race.
Her campaign website describes her as a nonprofit leader, health equity advocate and community servant.

paragraphs.text: Veleria Levy advanced from the Democratic primary on March 3, 2026.
Her campaign website says she is a mother and legal scholar who has led statewide health equity work, strengthened community organizations and built coalitions.
The site lists healthcare, infrastructure, education, constituent services, living wages, affordable housing and veterans care among her campaign priorities.
